'''Canistel AgriStar''' was a company based on [[New Canistel]]. Two of its [[X-19 barge]]s loaded with [[senoti]] seeds were lost while traveling through the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]]. Some xenoarborists believed one or both of them crashed on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], explaining the presence of senoti trees there.
